text:
maria: hey all — first day! laptop and dock arrived but two hiccups. figured i'd post here in case someone else hits this.

maria: issue A) when i try to join Corp-WiFi it errors: 'Certificate verification failed: untrusted root - Redwood-CA' 

maria: issue B) the aux adapter in the kit is a USB-A combo (ethernet+hdmi) while my laptop is USB-C only so it won't sit flush on the dock. ticket TKT-20912 opened.

sarah-onboarding: welcome to Redwood, maria! :tada: tagging IT and ops. quick q — did the laptop come pre-enrolled or did you do the self-enroll step from the welcome doc?

maria: i followed the welcome doc enrollment link yesterday but i don't remember seeing a 'Device enrolled' message.

derek-it: hey maria — welcome. that cert error usually means the CA profile didn't make it onto the system keychain. can you share macOS version (Apple > About This Mac) and run this in Terminal and paste output? ```/usr/bin/security find-certificate -a -c "Redwood-CA" -Z /Library/Keychains/System.keychain || echo NO_CERT```

maria: macOS 14.1. ran the command, it returned: NO_CERT

derek-it: okay that confirms it. check System Settings > Profiles for a 'Redwood Device Enrollment' or 'Redwood MDM' entry. if absent i'll re-push the enrollment.

maria: profiles is empty. saw one prompt earlier about vpn but didn't accept it.

derek-it: don't accept random prompts; i'll trigger a fresh enrollment push now. you should get a modal asking to install the profile. Accept and then reboot. i will also attach the CA cert to the profile so wifi joins cleanly.

ashley-ops: FYI we have a USB-C ethernet+hdmi dongle in the new-hire locker on level 2. Locker 5 code 4310. maria, want me to leave it there or do you want us to create a swap and ship one?

maria: leaving it for pickup would be perfect, thanks ashley! i'll swing by after standup.

derek-it: pushed enrollment, you should see a profile prompt in ~5 min. when it appears click Install, then reboot and try joining Corp-WiFi. if anything looks off take a screenshot and drop it here.

maria: prompt showed up, installed. rebooting now.
maria: reconnected to Corp-WiFi, works now :relieved: thanks derek.
maria: also picked up the USB-C dongle from locker 5, plugged in and ethernet + external display both work.
derek-it: great, i'll update TKT-20912 with resolution steps (MDM re-push and locker replacement). closing once you confirm everything stays green.
sarah-onboarding: welcome aboard again, maria! feel free to post any first-week questions here or DM me.
maria: thanks everyone — everything green, closing thread. :thumbsup:
